jobs.company: Accenture Solution Pvt Ltd () Cloud Migration & Imp Associate
robust security architectures for enterprise-wide systems, applications, and networks
bullets: ▶ Lead Security Architecture Design: Spearheaded the development and implementation of robust security architectures for enterprise-wide systems, applications, and networks, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and compliance requirements. ▶ Risk Management & Vulnerability Mitigation: Directed comprehensive threat assessments and vulnerability analysis, identifying critical security risks, and implementing strategic solutions to mitigate threats and enhance the organization's overall security posture. ▶ Team Leadership & Development: Managed and mentored a team of security architects and engineers, fostering collaboration, skill development, and continuous improvement to drive the execution of complex security projects across multiple business units. ▶ Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnered with key stakeholders, including IT, development, and compliance teams, to integrate security principles into the SDLC and ensure alignment with regulatory requirements (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR). ▶ Strategic Security Planning & Incident Response: Led the development of security strategies, including incident response and disaster recovery plans, and oversaw the successful resolution of security incidents, ensuring minimal impact on business operations and system integrity.

jobs.company: Infinite Computer Solutions Ltd () Sr. Lead Consultant
bullets: ▶ 5G Network Deployment & Management: Led the implementation and deployment of 5G network solutions, focusing on the management of IP/MPLS transport networks based on ring architecture, ensuring high availability and scalability. ▶ Advanced Router & Switch Configuration: Configured and troubleshooted high-end routers (Cisco, Nokia) and switches (Nexus, IOS) with protocols like OSPF, ISIS, MPLS, LDP, RSVP, BGP, VDC, and VPC, optimizing performance and connectivity across complex network infrastructures. ▶ Migration & MOP Documentation: Prepared and executed Method of Procedure (MOP) documents in accordance with network migration plans, ensuring smooth transitions during upgrades and network changes with minimal disruption. ▶ Network ATP Testing & Troubleshooting: Conducted Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP) for network deployments, providing troubleshooting documentation and ensuring network functionality was thoroughly tested before final deployment. ▶ Proactive Network Monitoring & SNMP Logging: Set up proactive monitoring tools and SNMP logging for all network devices to ensure real-time status updates.

▶ Feasible Design Solutions: Derived and delivered design solutions based on product development requirements, ensuring technical feasibility and alignment with business objectives. ▶ Network & Data Center Design: Developed and documented High-Level and Low-Level Designs (HLD/LLD) for networks and Data Center solutions, ensuring scalability and performance. ▶ Migration Planning & Execution: Prepared MOPs for network migration plans and executed successful migrations with minimal disruption. ▶ Network Testing & Monitoring: Led network testing (system, integration, UAT) and setup proactive monitoring, SNMP logging, and troubleshooting documentation for network devices. ▶ Strategic Planning & Impact Assessment: Directed strategic network planning, impact assessments, and risk management for network upgrades, expansions, and new deployments.

▶ Data Center Implementation & NOC Operations: Managed the implementation and operations of Data Centers, handling Nexus, routers, switches, and migrations. ▶ Hands-on Experience: Worked directly with F5 load balancers, Silver Peak, and Palo Alto firewalls for various network optimization and security tasks. ▶ P1 & P2 Ticket Handling: Acted as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), managing critical P1/P2 tickets, collaborating with OEMs, and providing customer solutions on Network Management Systems (NMS). ▶ ITIL Process Adherence: Followed ITIL processes for incident, change, and problem management to ensure smooth operations and quick resolutions. ▶ LAB Setup & Customer Demos: Led lab setups, simulations, testing of new features, and customer demos/POCs for network solutions.

▶ Troubleshoot Critical Network Incidents: Managed and resolved major network incidents, ensuring minimal disruption and quick recovery. ▶ Major Change Management: Reviewed and executed major network changes, ensuring smooth transitions and minimal impact on operations. ▶ L2 & L1 Team Support: Assisted L2 and L1 teams, handling escalated cases and providing advanced troubleshooting expertise. ▶ LAN/WAN Configuration & Maintenance: Configured, tested, and maintained LAN/WAN equipment and associated services for optimal performance. ▶ Wireless Network Support: Addressed wireless network issues and identified areas for improvement to enhance performance and reliability. ▶ 4G Network Implementation & Deployment: Managed the deployment and implementation of 4G network solutions, focusing on IP/MPLS transport networks and Cisco’s Unified MPLS Metro Transport Architecture.

Worked with LTE, IMS, FTTX, and Wi-Fi-based architectures. ▶ High-End Router & Switch Troubleshooting: Provided expert troubleshooting on high-end routers and switches, working with protocols like OSPF, ISIS, BGP, VDC, and VPC to ensure optimal network performance. ▶ Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Led root cause analysis of network failures, addressing protocol and hardware issues in the core network, including Cisco, Juniper, and other devices, to minimize downtime and maintain service continuity. ▶ ITIL Change & Incident Management: Followed ITIL processes for change management, incident management, and problem management.

Conducted planned outages for tasks like IOS upgrades, hardware replacements, and service migrations. ▶ Vendor Coordination & Troubleshooting: Coordinated with vendors such as Juniper and Cisco for critical faults, following up with TAC for joint troubleshooting to quickly resolve customer issues and reduce service disruptions. ▶ Network Monitoring & Fault Management: Monitored network performance using NMS tools like IP/MPLS, Cisco Prime, HP NNMi, and TeMIP Portal, managing real-time network alarms, faults, and ticketing via HPSM. ▶ LTE, DRA, IMS, FTTX & Wi-Fi Expertise: Applied in-depth knowledge of LTE, DRA, IMS, FTTX, and Wi-Fi services to ensure the deployment and maintenance of modern communication networks.

RF Engineers to provide technical assistance. ▶ Customer Satisfaction: Delivered optimal network performance to ensure customer satisfaction. ▶ Network Planning & Design: Designed customer networks, considering existing devices, infrastructure, and IP schemes. ▶ NOC Network Infrastructure Maintenance: Maintained network infrastructure and established WAN connectivity to remote sites. ▶ Device Setup & Configuration: Configured and set up switches (2960, 3650) and routers (Cisco 1800, 2800, 7609, 1209). ▶ Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Used HP TeMIP and other NMS tools for site integration and troubleshooting. ▶ Client & Provider Coordination: Coordinated with clients and providers to resolve network queries and issues. ▶ Video Conferencing Setup: Set up video conferencing systems using POLYCOM, TV, and ISDN lines.
